test_title: SSC CPO Tier-II Previous Year Paper (Held On: 8th November 2021)
subject: general
question: According to the passage, war would seem absurd to us if:

options.text: we have political contests among nations
we could live without fighting wars for a few years
we impose limitations on the people through law
we settle our disputes by organising duels

solution:
The correct answer is** 'we could live without fighting wars for a few years.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's have a look at the last sentence of the passage: 

 
 
• *' *If the world could live for a few generations without war, war would come to seem as absurd as duelling has come to seem to us.*'*
 
• Therefore, ​it can be concluded that according to the passage, war would seem absurd to us if we could live without fighting wars for a few years. (यह निष्कर्ष निकाला जा सकता है कि passage के अनुसार, युद्ध हमें बेतुका लगेगा यदि हम कुछ वर्षों तक युद्ध लड़े बिना रह सकते हैं।।).
 
 
 
• *​*Hence, the correct answer is 'we could live without fighting wars for a few years.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 

 

 
• The meaning of the word 'duel' is* *a contest with deadly weapons arranged between two people in order to settle a point of honour. ('Duel' शब्द का अर्थ है सम्मान के एक बिंदु को निपटाने के लिए दो लोगों के बीच घातक हथियारों के साथ एक प्रतियोगिता की व्यवस्था की गई।).

 
 
• Example: *Twice he had seriously wounded men in **duels**.*
